trigger_condition: on_tool_error/on_tool_start see different author values for the same run_id
guard_snippet: discard str(run_id) from every author bucket in _inflight_run_ids, not only self._inflight_run_ids[author]
potential_consequence: run_id leaks forever in the original author's inflight set, permanently blocking future streak aliasing for that author

trigger_condition: a top-level 'updates' dict has a subagent-echo key plus another legitimate node key in the same emission
guard_snippet: drop only the matched subagent-name keys from value before processing, not the whole value dict
potential_consequence: a co-occurring supervisor-level state update sharing the tick is silently dropped, not just the echo

trigger_condition: queue-poll loop calls _get_queue_poll_timeout_seconds() on every received chunk
guard_snippet: cache the resolved timeout on the handler instance the same way _get_max_consecutive_tool_errors_cache does
potential_consequence: a DynamicConfigService lookup fires per streamed chunk instead of once, hammering config/DB under load

trigger_condition: AI_AGENT_QUEUE_POLL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS dynamic override is set to 0 or a negative number
guard_snippet: return max(1, value) as _get_max_consecutive_tool_errors already does for its own cap
potential_consequence: queue.get(timeout=negative) raises ValueError uncaught, or timeout=0 causes an immediate false timeout

trigger_condition: an unclassified exception falls back to InternalError while include_tool_errors=True and HIDE_AGENT_STREAMING_EXCEPTIONS=True
guard_snippet: if config.HIDE_AGENT_STREAMING_EXCEPTIONS and error_response.category != ErrorCategory.AGENT: strip details.traceback from error_payload before dumping
potential_consequence: error_details still carries the full raw traceback from InternalError.details.traceback, leaking it to the client

trigger_condition: the queue-poll timeout fires while config.HIDE_AGENT_STREAMING_EXCEPTIONS is True
guard_snippet: redact agent_error.stacktrace in _build_timeout_result the same way _send_error_to_thread does before building error_details
potential_consequence: the timeout SSE chunk's agent_error/error_details always includes the raw stacktrace regardless of the hide-exceptions flag

trigger_condition: remote A2A agent never invokes task_callback with final=True
guard_snippet: value = generator_queue.queue.get(timeout=self._get_queue_poll_timeout_seconds()) with the same queue.Empty handling as _serve_data
potential_consequence: A2AAssistantHandler.stream_generator blocks forever on queue.get(), unlike the two sibling paths this diff converted

trigger_condition: a run completes successfully overall but recorded recoverable tool_errors/agent_error along the way
guard_snippet: populate tool_errors/agent_error on the success-path StreamedGenerationResult sent from LangGraphAgent.stream() when include_tool_errors is True
potential_consequence: tool_errors gathered during an otherwise-successful run are no longer surfaced to the client at all
